+# device pieces Plain trace-time helpers (no staged control flow inside; every branch is
+# a predicate), called from the kernel.
+class _Ctx:
+    """Per-thread values the pieces share (a namespace, filled by the kernel)."""
+
+    base: Any
+    CL: Any
+    done_cnt: Any
+    g: Any
+    HPC: Any
+    HQ: Any
+    k_base: Any
+    k_page: Any
+    k_tok: Any
+    kvh: Any
+    kvr: Any
+    l4: Any
+    lane: Any
+    ln: Any
+    nsel: Any
+    ntr: Any
+    num_sf_k_tiles: Any
+    out: Any
+    out_tok: Any
+    PPC: Any
+    q_addr: Any
+    q_dst: Any
+    q8: Any
+    qh: Any
+    qk_scale_log2: Any
+    rank: Any
+    rbar: Any
+    sf: Any
+    sfp: Any
+    st: Any
+    tb: Any
+    tch: Any
+    tid: Any
+    tok: Any
+    trow: Any
+    v_base: Any
+    v_page: Any
+    v_scale: Any
+    v_tok: Any
+    warp: Any
+
+
+def _load_q(c):
+    if c.HQ == MMA_ROWS:
+        w = _ld_v4(c.q_addr, False)
+    else:  # the MMA's padding rows (h >= HQ) are zero
+        w = _ld_v4_if(c.q_addr, I32(c.qh < I32(c.HQ)), False)
+    h16 = _cvt16(w)
+    _sts_v4(c.q_dst, h16[0:4])
+    _sts_v4(c.q_dst + I32(16), h16[4:8])
+
+
+def _fetch(c, slot):
+    """Register prefetch of one selected page into c.kvr (K words 0..31, V words 32..63; thread covers token rows
+    i * 16 + tid / 8, bytes (tid % 8) * 16) and its token count into c.ntr (0 when the slot is past the selection)."""
+    page = _ld_b32_if(c.tb + I64(slot) * I64(4), I32(slot < c.nsel), I32(-1))
+    last = c.ln - (c.nsel - I32(1)) * I32(PAGE)
+    nt = cutlass.select_(slot == c.nsel - I32(1), last, I32(PAGE))
+    nt = cutlass.select_(page < I32(0), I32(0), nt)
+    pg = I64(cutlass.select_(page > I32(0), page, I32(0)))
+    kb = c.k_base + pg * c.k_page + I64(c.tch)
+    vb = c.v_base + pg * c.v_page + I64(c.tch)
+    for i in range(8):
+        row = c.trow + I32(i * 16)
+        valid = I32(row < nt)
+        kw = _ld_v4_if(kb + I64(row) * c.k_tok, valid, True)
+        vw = _ld_v4_if(vb + I64(row) * c.v_tok, valid, True)
+        for e in range(4):
+            c.kvr[4 * i + e] = kw[e]
+            c.kvr[32 + 4 * i + e] = vw[e]
+    c.ntr[0] = nt
+
+
+def _row_reduce(c, op, dst):
+    """dst[h] = op over the 4 warps' `red[w][h]` (threads h < 16; the others read row 0 and store nothing)."""
+    lt = I32(c.tid < I32(MMA_ROWS))
+    red_t = (
+        c.base
+        + I32(RED)
+        + cutlass.select_(c.tid < I32(MMA_ROWS), c.tid, I32(0)) * I32(4)
+    )
+    r0 = _lds_f32(red_t)
+    r1 = _lds_f32(red_t + I32(64))
+    r2 = _lds_f32(red_t + I32(128))
+    r3 = _lds_f32(red_t + I32(192))
+    _sts_f32_if(c.base + I32(dst) + c.tid * I32(4), op(op(r0, r1), op(r2, r3)), lt)
+
+
+def _page(c, j, slot):
+    """One selected page: stage K / V, S = q k^T, online softmax update, O += P V (state in c.st)."""
+    base, lane, warp, g, l4 = c.base, c.lane, c.warp, c.g, c.l4
+    for i in range(8):
+        row = c.trow + I32(i * 16)
+        _sts_v4(
+            base + I32(KS) + row * I32(KPITCH) + c.tch,
+            [c.kvr[4 * i + e] for e in range(4)],
+        )
+        vh = _cvt16([c.kvr[32 + 4 * i + e] for e in range(4)])
+        vd = base + I32(VS) + (row * I32(PITCH) + c.tch) * I32(2)
+        _sts_v4(vd, vh[0:4])
+        _sts_v4(vd + I32(16), vh[4:8])
+    cur = c.ntr[0]
+    _bar_sync()
+    if j + 1 < c.PPC:
+        _fetch(c, slot + I32(c.CL))  # in flight during this page's compute
+
+    # S = q k^T: warp w covers tokens 32 w .. 32 w + 31 (4 n8 tiles).
+    sacc = [[F32(0.0)] * 4 for _ in range(4)]
+    a_row = (
+        base
+        + I32(QS)
+        + ((lane & I32(15)) * I32(PITCH) + (lane >> I32(4)) * I32(8)) * I32(2)
+    )
+    k_row = (
+        base + I32(KS) + (warp * I32(32) + (lane >> I32(2))) * I32(KPITCH) + l4 * I32(2)
+    )
+    for ks in range(DIM // 16):
+        a = _ldsm_x4(a_row + I32(ks * 32), False)
+        for jj in range(4):
+            kr = k_row + I32(jj * 8 * KPITCH + ks * 16)
+            sacc[jj] = _mma(sacc[jj], a, _lds_cvt(kr), _lds_cvt(kr + I32(8)))
+    mloc = [F32(NEG_INF), F32(NEG_INF)]
+    for jj in range(4):
+        for i in range(4):
+            t = warp * I32(32) + I32(jj * 8 + (i & 1)) + I32(2) * l4
+            sv = cutlass.select_(
+                t < cur, _fma(sacc[jj][i], c.qk_scale_log2, F32(0.0)), F32(NEG_INF)
+            )
+            sacc[jj][i] = sv
+            mloc[i >> 1] = _fmax(mloc[i >> 1], sv)
+    for r in range(2):
+        mloc[r] = _fmax(mloc[r], _shfl_bfly(mloc[r], 1))
+        mloc[r] = _fmax(mloc[r], _shfl_bfly(mloc[r], 2))
+    red_w = base + I32(RED) + (warp * I32(MMA_ROWS) + g) * I32(4)
+    lead = I32(l4 == I32(0))
+    _sts_f32_if(red_w, mloc[0], lead)
+    _sts_f32_if(red_w + I32(32), mloc[1], lead)
+    _bar_sync()
+    _row_reduce(c, _fmax, ROWM)
+    _bar_sync()
+    m_new = [None, None]
+    fac = [None, None]
+    for r in range(2):
+        m_old = c.st[16 + r]
+        m_new[r] = _fmax(m_old, _lds_f32(base + I32(ROWM) + (g + I32(8 * r)) * I32(4)))
+        fac[r] = cutlass.select_(
+            m_old == F32(NEG_INF), F32(0.0), _ex2(_sub(m_old, m_new[r]))
+        )
+        c.st[16 + r] = m_new[r]
+    lloc = [F32(0.0), F32(0.0)]
+    for jj in range(4):
+        for i in (0, 2):
+            r = i >> 1
+            p0 = _ex2(_sub(sacc[jj][i], m_new[r]))
+            p1 = _ex2(_sub(sacc[jj][i + 1], m_new[r]))
+            lloc[r] = _add(lloc[r], _add(p0, p1))
+            t = warp * I32(32) + I32(jj * 8) + I32(2) * l4
+            _sts_b32(
+                base + I32(PS) + ((g + I32(8 * r)) * I32(PITCH) + t) * I32(2),
+                _f16x2(p0, p1),
+            )
+    for r in range(2):
+        lloc[r] = _add(lloc[r], _shfl_bfly(lloc[r], 1))
+        lloc[r] = _add(lloc[r], _shfl_bfly(lloc[r], 2))
+    _bar_sync()
+    _sts_f32_if(red_w, lloc[0], lead)
+    _sts_f32_if(red_w + I32(32), lloc[1], lead)
+    acc = [[c.st[4 * jj + i] for i in range(4)] for jj in range(4)]
+    for jj in range(4):
+        acc[jj][0] = _mul(fac[0], acc[jj][0])
+        acc[jj][1] = _mul(fac[0], acc[jj][1])
+        acc[jj][2] = _mul(fac[1], acc[jj][2])
+        acc[jj][3] = _mul(fac[1], acc[jj][3])
+    # O += P V: warp w covers dims 32 w .. 32 w + 31.
+    p_row = (
+        base
+        + I32(PS)
+        + ((lane & I32(15)) * I32(PITCH) + (lane >> I32(4)) * I32(8)) * I32(2)
+    )
+    v_t = (lane & I32(7)) + ((lane >> I32(3)) & I32(1)) * I32(8)
+    v_d = warp * I32(32) + (lane >> I32(4)) * I32(8)
+    for kk in range(PAGE // 16):
+        a = _ldsm_x4(p_row + I32(kk * 32), False)
+        for jp in range(2):
+            b = _ldsm_x4(
+                base
+                + I32(VS)
+                + ((v_t + I32(kk * 16)) * I32(PITCH) + v_d + I32(jp * 16)) * I32(2),
+                True,
+            )
+            acc[2 * jp] = _mma(acc[2 * jp], a, b[0], b[1])
+            acc[2 * jp + 1] = _mma(acc[2 * jp + 1], a, b[2], b[3])
+    for jj in range(4):
+        for i in range(4):
+            c.st[4 * jj + i] = acc[jj][i]
+    _bar_sync()
+    _row_reduce(c, _add, ROWL)
+    _bar_sync()
+    for r in range(2):
+        c.st[18 + r] = _fma(
+            c.st[18 + r], fac[r], _lds_f32(base + I32(ROWL) + (g + I32(8 * r)) * I32(4))
+        )
+    _bar_sync()  # ks / vs / ps / rowl free for the next page
+
+
+def _push(c, r):
+    """Normalize the partial of Q row g + 8 r and push it with its LSE (log2) to CTA row / HPC, slot
+    (row % HPC, rank). Rows >= HQ (the MMA's padding at 8 heads) push nothing."""
+    l_r = c.st[18 + r]
+    has = l_r > F32(0.0)
+    scale = cutlass.select_(has, _f1("rcp.rn.f32", l_r), F32(0.0))
+    lse = cutlass.select_(
+        has, _add(c.st[16 + r], _f1("lg2.approx.f32", l_r)), F32(NEG_INF)
+    )
+    scale = _mul(scale, c.v_scale)
+    row = c.g + I32(8 * r)
+    dst_cta = row // I32(c.HPC)
+    slot = (row % I32(c.HPC)) * I32(c.CL) + c.rank
+    dst = _mapa(c.base + I32(RECV) + slot * I32(DIM * 4), dst_cta)
+    rb = _mapa(c.rbar, dst_cta)
+    for jj in range(4):
+        d = c.warp * I32(32) + I32(jj * 8) + I32(2) * c.l4
+        _st_async_v2(
+            dst + d * I32(4),
+            _mul(scale, c.st[4 * jj + 2 * r]),
+            _mul(scale, c.st[4 * jj + 2 * r + 1]),
+            rb,
+        )
+    lead = I32((c.warp == I32(0)) & (c.l4 == I32(0)))
+    _st_async_f32_if(_mapa(c.base + I32(R_LSE) + slot * I32(4), dst_cta), lse, rb, lead)
+
+
+def _merge(c):
+    """Merge the HPC heads of this CTA by their LSE; bf16 output + MXFP8 (values, swizzled and row-major scales)."""
+    base, tid, lane, warp, tok = c.base, c.tid, c.lane, c.warp, c.tok
+    for hi in range(c.HPC):
+        h = c.kvh * I32(c.HQ) + c.rank * I32(c.HPC) + I32(hi)
+        lse_c = [_lds_f32(base + I32(R_LSE + (hi * c.CL + j) * 4)) for j in range(c.CL)]
+        lse_max = F32(NEG_INF)
+        for j in range(c.CL):
+            lse_max = _fmax(lse_max, lse_c[j])
+        lse_max = cutlass.select_(lse_max == F32(NEG_INF), F32(0.0), lse_max)
+        denom = F32(0.0)
+        for j in range(c.CL):
+            lse_c[j] = _ex2(_sub(lse_c[j], lse_max))
+            denom = _add(denom, lse_c[j])
+        denom = cutlass.select_(denom > F32(0.0), denom, F32(1.0))
+        o = F32(0.0)
+        for j in range(c.CL):
+            rv = _lds_f32(base + I32(RECV + (hi * c.CL + j) * DIM * 4) + tid * I32(4))
+            o = _fma(rv, _f2("div.rn.f32", lse_c[j], denom), o)
+        ob = _bf16_hi(o)
+        col = h * I32(DIM) + tid
+        _st_b16_hi(c.out + I64(tok) * c.out_tok + I64(col) * I64(2), ob)
+
+        x = _float(ob)
+        amax = _f1("abs.f32", x)
+        for off in (16, 8, 4, 2, 1):
+            amax = _fmax(amax, _shfl_bfly(amax, off))
+        sfv = _mul(amax, _f1("rcp.approx.ftz.f32", F32(448.0)))
+        sb = _bits(sfv)
+        e = ((sb >> I32(23)) & I32(0xFF)) + I32((sb & I32(0x7FFFFF)) != I32(0))
+        e = cutlass.select_(e < I32(254), e, I32(254))
+        qs = cutlass.select_(
+            amax != F32(0.0), _float((I32(254) - e) << I32(23)), F32(0.0)
+        )
+        xq = _mul(x, qs)
+        _st_b8(
+            c.q8 + I64(tok) * I64(c.num_sf_k_tiles * I32(128)) + I64(col), _e4m3_lo(xq)
+        )
+        k_sf = h * I32(4) + warp
+        sf_off = (
+            I64(tok // I32(128)) * I64(c.num_sf_k_tiles) * I64(512)
+            + I64((k_sf >> I32(2)) * I32(512))
+            + I64(
+                (tok & I32(31)) * I32(16)
+                + ((tok & I32(127)) >> I32(5)) * I32(4)
+                + (k_sf & I32(3))
+            )
+        )
+        l0 = lane == I32(0)
+        _st_b8_if(c.sf + sf_off, e, I32(l0 & (c.sf != I64(0))))
+        _st_b8_if(
+            c.sfp + I64(tok) * I64(c.num_sf_k_tiles * I32(4)) + I64(k_sf), e, I32(l0)
+        )
+
+
+def _finish(c, sync: bool):
+    if sync:
+        _bar_sync()
+    _red_release_add1_if(c.done_cnt, I32((c.tid == I32(0)) & (c.done_cnt != I64(0))))
+    _launch_dependents()
+
+
+# ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ kernel
+@cute.kernel
+def sparse_decode_kernel(
+    q: I64, q_tok: I64, q_head: I64,  # type: ignore[valid-type]  # e4m3 [T, Hq, 128]; byte strides
+    k: I64, v: I64, k_page: I64, k_head: I64, k_tok: I64, v_page: I64, v_head: I64, v_tok: I64,  # type: ignore[valid-type]  # e4m3 pages
+    tables: I64, tb_head: I64, tb_tok: I64,  # type: ignore[valid-type]  # int32 [Hkv, T, >= 16]; byte strides
+    lens: I64, ln_head: I64,  # type: ignore[valid-type]  # int32 [Hkv, T]; byte stride of the head dim
+    qk_scale_log2: F32, v_scale: F32,  # type: ignore[valid-type]
+    out: I64, out_tok: I64,  # type: ignore[valid-type]  # bf16 [T, Hq * 128]; byte stride
+    q8: I64, sf: I64, sfp: I64,  # type: ignore[valid-type]  # MXFP8 values / 128x4-swizzled scales (0 = none) / row-major scales
+    done_cnt: I64,  # type: ignore[valid-type]  # u64 completion counter (0 = none)
+    num_sf_k_tiles: I32, num_kv_heads: I32, prewait: I32,  # type: ignore[valid-type]
+    CL: cutlass.Constexpr[int], HQ: cutlass.Constexpr[int], PRE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    SMEM: cutlass.Constexpr[int],
+):  # fmt: skip
+    c = _Ctx()
+    c.CL, c.HQ, c.PPC = CL, HQ, TOPK // CL
+    c.HPC = heads_per_cta(HQ, CL)
+    NRECV = HQ // c.HPC
+    c.qk_scale_log2, c.v_scale = qk_scale_log2, v_scale
+    c.k_page, c.v_page, c.k_tok, c.v_tok = k_page, v_page, k_tok, v_tok
+    c.out, c.out_tok, c.q8, c.sf, c.sfp, c.done_cnt, c.num_sf_k_tiles = (
+        out,
+        out_tok,
+        q8,
+        sf,
+        sfp,
+        done_cnt,
+        num_sf_k_tiles,
+    )
+    tid, _, _ = cute.arch.thread_idx()
+    bid, _, _ = cute.arch.block_idx()
+    c.tid = I32(tid)
+    bid = I32(bid)
+    c.lane = c.tid & I32(31)
+    c.warp = c.tid >> I32(5)
+    c.g = c.lane >> I32(2)
+    c.l4 = c.lane & I32(3)
+    cid = bid // I32(CL)
+    c.tok = cid // num_kv_heads
+    c.kvh = cid - c.tok * num_kv_heads
+    c.rank = _cluster_rank()
+
+    sm = cutlass.Array(
+        cutlass.Uint8, SMEM, space=cutlass.AddressSpace.smem, alignment=1024
+    )
+    c.base = I32(sm.data_ptr().toint())
+    c.rbar = c.base + I32(RBAR)
+
+    if cutlass.const_expr(NRECV == CL):
+        nbytes = I32(recv_bytes(HQ, CL))
+    else:
+        nbytes = cutlass.select_(c.rank < I32(NRECV), I32(recv_bytes(HQ, CL)), I32(0))
+    if c.tid == I32(0):
+        _mbar_init_expect(c.rbar, nbytes)
+    _cluster_arrive_relaxed()
+
+    # q -> fp16 rows of the MMA tile: thread covers head tid >> 3, bytes (tid & 7) * 16 .. + 15.
+    c.qh = c.tid >> I32(3)
+    qc = (c.tid & I32(7)) * I32(16)
+    c.q_addr = q + I64(c.tok) * q_tok + I64(c.kvh * I32(HQ) + c.qh) * q_head + I64(qc)
+    c.q_dst = c.base + I32(QS) + (c.qh * I32(PITCH) + qc) * I32(2)
+
+    len_addr = lens + I64(c.kvh) * ln_head + I64(c.tok) * I64(4)
+    if cutlass.const_expr(PRE):
+        pre_len = I32((prewait & I32(1)) != I32(0))
+        len_early = _ld_b32_if(len_addr, pre_len, I32(0))
+        if (prewait & I32(2)) != I32(0):
+            _load_q(c)
+        _grid_wait()
+        _launch_dependents()
+        if (prewait & I32(2)) == I32(0):
+            _load_q(c)
+        ln = _ld_b32_if(len_addr, I32(1) - pre_len, len_early)
+    else:
+        _grid_wait()
+        _launch_dependents()
+        _load_q(c)
+        ln = _ld_b32_if(len_addr, I32(1), I32(0))
+    c.ln = ln
+    nsel = cutlass.select_(ln > I32(0), ln, I32(0))
+    nsel = (nsel + I32(PAGE - 1)) >> I32(7)
+    c.nsel = cutlass.select_(nsel < I32(TOPK), nsel, I32(TOPK))
+    c.tb = tables + I64(c.kvh) * tb_head + I64(c.tok) * tb_tok
+    c.k_base = k + I64(c.kvh) * k_head
+    c.v_base = v + I64(c.kvh) * v_head
+    c.trow = c.tid >> I32(3)
+    c.tch = (c.tid & I32(7)) * I32(16)
+
+    # Register prefetch of one page and its token count, and the softmax state (acc
+    # [4][4], m_row [2], l_row [2]), in rmem across the page loop.
+    c.kvr = cute.make_rmem_tensor((64,), I32)
+    c.ntr = cute.make_rmem_tensor((1,), I32)
+    c.st = cute.make_rmem_tensor((20,), F32)
+    for i in cutlass.range_constexpr(16):
+        c.st[i] = F32(0.0)
+    c.st[16] = F32(NEG_INF)
+    c.st[17] = F32(NEG_INF)
+    c.st[18] = F32(0.0)
+    c.st[19] = F32(0.0)
+
+    _fetch(c, c.rank)
+    for j in cutlass.range_constexpr(TOPK // CL):
+        slot = c.rank + I32(j * CL)
+        if slot < c.nsel:  # slots increase in j; uniform across the CTA
+            _page(c, j, slot)
+
+    _cluster_wait()
+    for r in cutlass.range_constexpr(2):
+        if cutlass.const_expr(
+            HQ == MMA_ROWS or 8 * r < HQ
+        ):  # rows >= HQ are the MMA's padding (8 heads: r = 1)
+            _push(c, r)
+
+    if cutlass.const_expr(NRECV == CL):
+        while _try_wait_cluster(c.rbar) == I32(0):
+            pass
+        _merge(c)
+        _finish(c, True)
+    else:
+        if c.rank < I32(NRECV):
+            while _try_wait_cluster(c.rbar) == I32(0):
+                pass
+            _merge(c)
+            _finish(c, True)
+        else:  # no head to merge (8 heads, CL 16)
+            _finish(c, False)
+
+
+@cute.jit
+def sparse_decode_launch(
+    q: I64, q_tok: I64, q_head: I64,  # type: ignore[valid-type]
+    k: I64, v: I64, k_page: I64, k_head: I64, k_tok: I64, v_page: I64, v_head: I64, v_tok: I64,  # type: ignore[valid-type]
+    tables: I64, tb_head: I64, tb_tok: I64, lens: I64, ln_head: I64,  # type: ignore[valid-type]
+    qk_scale_log2: F32, v_scale: F32,  # type: ignore[valid-type]
+    out: I64, out_tok: I64, q8: I64, sf: I64, sfp: I64, done_cnt: I64,  # type: ignore[valid-type]
+    num_sf_k_tiles: I32, num_kv_heads: I32, prewait: I32, grid: I32,  # type: ignore[valid-type]
+    CL: cutlass.Constexpr[int], HQ: cutlass.Constexpr[int], PRE: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    MINB: cutlass.Constexpr[int], use_pdl: cutlass.Constexpr[bool],
+    stream: cuda_driver.CUstream, CAP: cutlass.Constexpr[int] = 0,
+):  # fmt: skip
+    sparse_decode_kernel(
+        q, q_tok, q_head, k, v, k_page, k_head, k_tok, v_page, v_head, v_tok, tables, tb_head, tb_tok, lens, ln_head,
+        qk_scale_log2, v_scale, out, out_tok, q8, sf, sfp, done_cnt, num_sf_k_tiles, num_kv_heads, prewait,
+        CL, HQ, PRE, smem_alloc(CAP),
+    ).launch(
+        grid=(grid, 1, 1),
+        block=(THREADS, 1, 1),
+        cluster=(CL, 1, 1),
+        stream=stream,
+        use_pdl=use_pdl,
+        min_blocks_per_mp=MINB,
+        max_number_threads=[THREADS, 1, 1],
+    )  # fmt: skip

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The kernels of steps wider than the fused kernels' rows (9..64 rows).
+
+The fused o_proj / post / MoE engine kernels hold at most 8 rows (the engine's
+slot tiling, the router CTAs' register shape). Wider steps (c = 2..8 requests
+x 8 rows at K = 7) run these slots instead:
+
+==================  ===========================================================
+stage               wide implementation
+==================  ===========================================================
+front (17..64)      `WideFront`: after the stock input boundary (FlashInfer
+                    AR + norm), one MXFP8 quantize launch and the same GEMV on
+                    the QKV / index weight, then the stock q/k norm + RoPE +
+                    FP8 KV / index-K insert op.
+o_proj              `WideOProj`: the same MXFP8 GEMV (tcgen05, swapped AB:
+                    the weight is the M128 operand, the rows are the MMA's N =
+                    16 / 32 / 48 / 64 columns), so each o_proj weight tile is
+                    read once per step at any row count; it reads the kernel
+                    sparse decode's MXFP8 output in place (no requantize).
+                    BF16 partial out, no push.
+allreduce_norm      stock (FlashInfer's fused all-reduce + Gemma RMSNorm,
+                    the stock router GEMM).
+moe                 stock (above 8 rows the routed GEMMs stream nearly every
+                    expert's weights once either way).
+==================  ===========================================================
+
+Why not the push + post at these rows: the producer push writes 4-byte words
+to every peer, which is slower than FlashInfer's all-reduce + norm at 64 rows,
+and the MoE engine reads routes per slot. Why not the fused engine: at 32-64
+rows x top-4 most of the 128 experts are hit and the routed GEMMs stream
+nearly every expert's weights once either way, which FlashInfer's grouped
+GEMMs already do near the HBM roofline. A separate router + NVFP4 launch with
+FlashInfer's routed entry point measured slower end to end at c = 4 / 8 than
+the stock router GEMM + monolithic MoE.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from typing import Any
+
+import torch
+
+H = 6144
+KO = 2048  # o_proj input per rank at TP4 (16 heads x 128)
+MAX_ROWS = 64
+
+
+def _rows_ext():
+    from .post.host import row_ops
+
+    return row_ops()
+
+
+class WideError(RuntimeError):
+    pass
+
+
+class WideOProj:
+    """The o_proj MXFP8 GEMV at 9..64 rows on one layer's weight (no router
+    CTAs, no push): bf16 partial [rows, 6144] from the kernel sparse decode's
+    MXFP8 output."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, o_weight: torch.Tensor, o_weight_scale: torch.Tensor, out: torch.Tensor
+    ):
+        from .o_proj import host as gemv
+
+        self.gemv = gemv
+        if o_weight.shape != (H, KO) or o_weight.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn:
+            raise WideError(f"o_proj weight must be e4m3 [{H}, {KO}]")
+        self.w = o_weight.contiguous()
+        self.ws = o_weight_scale.contiguous().view(torch.uint8).reshape(-1)
+        self.out = out  # bf16 [64, 6144], shared by the layers (stream order)
+
+    def build(self, rows: tuple[int, ...]) -> None:
+        """Compile the MMA widths `rows` need (outside capture)."""
+        self.gemv.check_cute_dsl()
+        for m in rows:
+            if (
+                self.gemv.precompile(self.w, self.ws, m, x_bf16=False, use_pdl=True)
+                is None
+            ):
+                raise WideError(f"o_proj GEMV declines {m} rows")
+
+    def __call__(self, xq: torch.Tensor, xsf: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        rows = xq.shape[0]
+        y = self.gemv.m3_mx_gemv(
+            xq, xsf, self.w, self.ws, use_pdl=True, out=self.out[:rows]
+        )
+        if y is None:
+            raise WideError(
+                f"o_proj GEMV declined {rows} rows (uncompiled key "
+                f"{self.gemv.last_uncompiled})"
+            )
+        return y
+
+
+class WideFront:
+    """The QKV / index projection of a sparse layer at 17..64 rows: MXFP8 of
+    the normed BF16 rows (`mxfp8_rows`, trtllm `mxfp8_quantize` rounding)
+    and the GEMV on the layer's MXFP8 `qkv_proj` weight (rows =
+    q | k | v | index q | index k heads x 128)."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        qkv_weight: torch.Tensor,
+        qkv_weight_scale: torch.Tensor,
+        xq: torch.Tensor,
+        xsf: torch.Tensor,
+        out: torch.Tensor,
+    ):
+        from .o_proj import host as gemv
+
+        self.gemv = gemv
+        if (
+            qkv_weight.dim() != 2
+            or qkv_weight.shape[1] != H
+            or qkv_weight.dtype != torch.float8_e4m3fn
+        ):
+            raise WideError(f"qkv weight must be e4m3 [N, {H}]")
+        self.w = qkv_weight.contiguous()
+        self.ws = qkv_weight_scale.contiguous().view(torch.uint8).reshape(-1)
+        self.n = self.w.shape[0]
+        self.xq, self.xsf = (
+            xq,
+            xsf,
+        )  # shared MXFP8 input buffers [64, H] / [128 * H / 32]
+        if out.shape[1] != self.n:
+            raise WideError(f"qkv out width {out.shape[1]} != {self.n}")
+        self.out = out  # bf16 [64, N], shared (stream order)
+        self._ext: Any = None
+
+    def build(self, rows: tuple[int, ...], compile_gemv: bool = True) -> None:
+        """Load the quantize extension; compile the GEMV for `rows` (once
+        per process: the compile key does not depend on the weight)."""
+        self._ext = _rows_ext()
+        self._ext.precompile()  # its first launch is inside a FULL graph capture
+        if not compile_gemv:
+            return
+        self.gemv.check_cute_dsl()
+        for m in rows:
+            if (
+                self.gemv.precompile(self.w, self.ws, m, x_bf16=False, use_pdl=True)
+                is None
+            ):
+                raise WideError(f"QKV GEMV declines {m} rows")
+
+    def __call__(self, hidden: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Qkv bf16 [rows, N] of the normed rows `hidden` (bf16 [rows, 6144])."""
+        rows = hidden.shape[0]
+        self._ext.mxfp8_rows(hidden, self.xq, self.xsf, rows)
+        return self.quantized(self.xq[:rows], self.xsf)
+
+    def quantized(self, xq: torch.Tensor, xsf: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """Qkv bf16 [rows, N] of rows already in MXFP8: e4m3 `xq` [rows,
+        6144] and UE8M0 `xsf` in the 128x4-swizzled layout (at least 128 x
+        192 bytes), as `mxfp8_rows` and the stock fused MoE finalize +
+        all-reduce + norm write them."""
+        rows = xq.shape[0]
+        y = self.gemv.m3_mx_gemv(
+            xq, xsf, self.w, self.ws, use_pdl=True, out=self.out[:rows]
+        )
+        if y is None:
+            raise WideError(
+                f"QKV GEMV declined {rows} rows (uncompiled key "
+                f"{self.gemv.last_uncompiled})"
+            )
+        return y

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""LM head outputs in peer-mapped memory: the vocabulary-parallel logits
+without an NCCL all-gather.
+
+The stock LM heads (target and draft) gather their `[rows, V / TP]` shards
+with an NCCL ring all-gather and a copy that moves the rank dimension into
+the vocabulary. Here each rank writes its shard with the head's own GEMM into
+a peer-mapped buffer (the TP group's peer transport), pushes it into every rank's
+`[rows, V]` logits buffer over NVLink, and one flag barrier makes every
+shard visible (`PeerPushedLogits`): for the target sampler
+(`runtime/model_state.py`) and the DSpark Markov sampling (`drafter.py`).
+
+Reuse is safe without a second barrier: between two uses of a buffer every
+rank runs collectives that the other ranks can only join after finishing
+their reads (the draft step's, the target forward's).
+
+The buffers, their peer handshake and the kernels' compiles happen in
+`warm_up`, which the model state runs on every rank at start-up, before
+memory profiling, so serving allocates and compiles nothing here.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.triton_utils import tl, triton
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["rank"])
+def _peer_barrier_kernel(epoch_ptr, flag_table_ptr, rank, WORLD: tl.constexpr):
+    """Every rank's previous kernels are done: bump the local epoch, store it
+    into this rank's slot of every rank's flags, wait for every slot of ours.
+
+    No rank can be a barrier ahead (see the module docstring), so a slot holds
+    the previous epoch or the current one. Epochs are int64: they never wrap.
+    """
+    epoch = tl.load(epoch_ptr) + 1
+    tl.store(epoch_ptr, epoch)
+    for peer in tl.static_range(WORLD):
+        flags = tl.load(flag_table_ptr + peer).to(tl.pointer_type(tl.int64))
+        tl.atomic_xchg(flags + rank, epoch, sem="release", scope="sys")
+    mine = tl.load(flag_table_ptr + rank).to(tl.pointer_type(tl.int64))
+    for peer in tl.static_range(WORLD):
+        seen = tl.atomic_add(mine + peer, 0, sem="acquire", scope="sys")
+        while seen < epoch:
+            seen = tl.atomic_add(mine + peer, 0, sem="acquire", scope="sys")
+
+
+@triton.jit(do_not_specialize=["rank", "shard_size", "vocab_size"])
+def _push_shard_kernel(
+    src_ptr,  # this rank's [rows, shard] GEMM output
+    table_ptr,  # int64 [WORLD]: every rank's [max_rows, vocab] full buffer
+    fence_ptr,  # int32 scratch for the release that ends each program
+    rank,
+    shard_size,
+    vocab_size,
+    DTYPE: tl.constexpr,
+    WORLD: tl.constexpr,
+    BLOCK: tl.constexpr,
+):
+    """Copy one block of this rank's shard row into every rank's full logits
+    (remote writes), then release them at system scope."""
+    row = tl.program_id(0).to(tl.int64)
+    col = tl.program_id(1) * BLOCK + tl.arange(0, BLOCK)
+    mask = col < shard_size
+    v = tl.load(src_ptr + row * shard_size + col, mask=mask)
+    dst = row * vocab_size + rank * shard_size + col
+    for p in tl.static_range(WORLD):
+        base = tl.multiple_of(tl.load(table_ptr + p).to(tl.pointer_type(DTYPE)), 16)
+        tl.store(base + dst, v, mask=mask)
+    tl.debug_barrier()
+    tl.atomic_add(fence_ptr, 0, sem="release", scope="sys")
+
+
+class PeerShards:
+    """`[max_rows, shard]` of this rank's LM head output in a peer-mapped
+    buffer, every rank's address (`table`), and the flag barrier."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self, weight: torch.Tensor, max_rows: int, name: str, extra_bytes: int = 0
+    ) -> None:
+        from vllm.distributed import get_tp_group
+
+        from .kernels._comm import make_transport
+
+        group = get_tp_group()
+        self.world, self.rank = group.world_size, group.rank_in_group
+        self.shard = weight.shape[0]
+        self.dtype = weight.dtype
+        self.max_rows = max_rows
+        nbytes = max_rows * self.shard * weight.element_size()
+        self._transport = make_transport(
+            "auto",
+            group=group.device_group,
+            cpu_group=group.cpu_group,
+            rank=self.rank,
+            world=self.world,
+            capacity=nbytes + extra_bytes + 8192,
+        )
+        logits = self._transport.alloc(name, nbytes)
+        flags = self._transport.alloc(name + "_flags", 8 * self.world)
+        self.local = logits.local.view(self.dtype).view(max_rows, self.shard)
+        device = weight.device
+        self.table = torch.tensor(logits.peer_ptrs, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+        self.flag_table = torch.tensor(
+            flags.peer_ptrs, dtype=torch.int64, device=device
+        )
+        self.epoch = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int64, device=device)
+
+    def barrier(self) -> None:
+        _peer_barrier_kernel[(1,)](
+            self.epoch, self.flag_table, self.rank, WORLD=self.world, num_warps=1
+        )
+
+
+_HEAD_DTYPES = (torch.bfloat16, torch.float16)
+
+
+def _tl_dtype(dtype: torch.dtype):
+    return {torch.bfloat16: tl.bfloat16, torch.float16: tl.float16}[dtype]
+
+
+def peer_logits_unsupported(lm_head: nn.Module, logits_processor: nn.Module) -> str:
+    """Why an LM head's logits cannot be read in place ("" when they can)."""
+    weight = getattr(lm_head, "weight", None)
+    if weight is None or weight.dim() != 2 or weight.dtype not in _HEAD_DTYPES:
+        return "a quantized LM head"
+    if getattr(lm_head, "bias", None) is not None:
+        return "an LM head bias"
+    if logits_processor.head_dtype not in (None, weight.dtype):
+        return "a separate head dtype"
+    if logits_processor.logits_as_input:
+        return "logits as input"
+    if logits_processor.scale != 1.0 or logits_processor.soft_cap is not None:
+        return "scaled or soft-capped logits"
+    if getattr(lm_head, "tp_size", 1) == 1:
+        return "a replicated LM head"
+    if (
+        lm_head.num_embeddings_padded != logits_processor.org_vocab_size
+        or lm_head.tp_size * weight.shape[0] != logits_processor.org_vocab_size
+    ):
+        return "a padded vocabulary"
+    return ""
+
+
+class PeerPushedLogits:
+    """`compute_logits` of a vocabulary-parallel LM head with each rank
+    pushing its shard into every rank's full logits buffer (remote writes)
+    instead of every rank reading the others' shards after the barrier:
+    the head's GEMM into the local shard buffer, one push, the barrier; the
+    logits are this rank's full buffer (rows reused by the next call)."""
+
+    BLOCK = 4096
+
+    def __init__(self, lm_head, logits_processor, max_rows: int, name: str):
+        self._lm_head = lm_head
+        self._name = name
+        self.vocab_size = logits_processor.org_vocab_size
+        self.max_rows = max_rows
+        self._shards: PeerShards | None = None
+        self._full: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self._table: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        self._fence: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+    def warm_up(self) -> None:
+        """Collective (every rank, same order, outside graph capture):
+        allocate the buffers, exchange their peer addresses and compile both
+        kernels with one push of a zero row and one barrier."""
+        weight = self._lm_head.weight
+        nbytes = self.max_rows * self.vocab_size * weight.element_size()
+        self._shards = PeerShards(weight, self.max_rows, self._name, nbytes + 256)
+        tr = self._shards._transport
+        full = tr.alloc(self._name + "_full", nbytes)
+        self._full = full.local.view(weight.dtype).view(self.max_rows, self.vocab_size)
+        self._table = torch.tensor(
+            full.peer_ptrs, dtype=torch.int64, device=weight.device
+        )
+        self._fence = torch.zeros(1, dtype=torch.int32, device=weight.device)
+        self._shards.local[:1].zero_()
+        self._push(1)
+        torch.accelerator.synchronize()
+
+    def __call__(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor | None:
+        rows = hidden_states.shape[0]
+        if hidden_states.dim() != 2 or rows == 0 or rows > self.max_rows:
+            return None
+        if self._shards is None:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"{self._name}: peer logits used before warm_up")
+        torch.mm(hidden_states, self._lm_head.weight.t(), out=self._shards.local[:rows])
+        self._push(rows)
+        return self._full[:rows]  # type: ignore[index]
+
+    def _push(self, rows: int) -> None:
+        shards: PeerShards = self._shards  # type: ignore[assignment]
+        weight = self._lm_head.weight
+        local = shards.local[:rows]
+        _push_shard_kernel[(rows, triton.cdiv(shards.shard, self.BLOCK))](
+            local,
+            self._table,
+            self._fence,
+            shards.rank,
+            shards.shard,
+            self.vocab_size,
+            DTYPE=_tl_dtype(weight.dtype),
+            WORLD=shards.world,
+            BLOCK=self.BLOCK,
+            num_warps=8,
+        )
+        shards.barrier()
+
+
+def peer_logits(lm_head, logits_processor, max_rows: int, name: str = "target_logits"):
+    """The peer-memory logits of an LM head: each rank pushes its shard
+    (faster than every rank reading the shards after the barrier)."""
+    return PeerPushedLogits(lm_head, logits_processor, max_rows, name)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The specialized decode executor.
+
+`SpecializedDecode` runs the decoder layers of `MiniMaxM3Model` for the
+steps captured into FULL CUDA graphs of pure decode batches of up to
+`max_rows` rows. Its model state builds it once the weights are loaded.
+`plan` decides per forward whether it runs; the model's forward then passes
+the returned `DecodeStep` to the backbone, which embeds the input as usual
+and hands the layers to `DecodeStep.run`. Every other forward (prefill,
+mixed, eager, PIECEWISE, larger batches) runs the stock layers, which the
+executor leaves unchanged.
+
+Per layer the executor runs the stock modules' weights through the stages of
+`stages.py`:
+
+- dense-attention layers (0-2): allreduce_norm.input -> front -> dense_decode
+  -> o_proj -> allreduce_norm.post_attention -> dense_mlp;
+- sparse-attention layers: allreduce_norm.input -> front -> index_score ->
+  page_topk -> sparse_decode -> o_proj -> allreduce_norm.post_attention
+  (+ router) -> moe (finalize deferred to the next input boundary when the
+  stock MoE defers it and the next front does not fuse that boundary);
+
+then allreduce_norm.final. A front that `fuses_input` replaces
+allreduce_norm.input + front with `run_fused`; a MoE whose next front
+`polls_push` pushes its output into that front's exchange. Each stage takes
+the first of its implementations that runs over the deployment's cache dtypes,
+supports the step's rows and is `compatible` with the other selected stages
+(`Stages.select`); the last is always the stock one (`stock.py`).
+
+The stages issue TP collectives, so every decision reads host state that all
+TP ranks share: the step's rows and the attention metadata's host fields.
+"""
+
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, NamedTuple, TypeAlias
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import CUDAGraphMode
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context, is_forward_context_available
+from vllm.sequence import IntermediateTensors
+
+from .. import DecodeConfig, max_rows
+from ..stages import Stages, StepStages
+from ..stock import stock_stages
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from ...model import MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer, MiniMaxM3Model
+
+DecodeOutput: TypeAlias = torch.Tensor | tuple[torch.Tensor, list[torch.Tensor]]
+
+
+class DecodeStep(NamedTuple):
+    """The host-side choices of one captured decode step, by its rows."""
+
+    rows: int
+    # The implementation of every stage for this step.
+    stages: StepStages
+    executor: "SpecializedDecode"
+
+    def run(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor) -> DecodeOutput:
+        """The backbone's output after its embedding."""
+        return self.executor.run(self, hidden_states, positions)
+
+
+class LayerPlan(NamedTuple):
+    layer_id: int
+    layer: "MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer"
+    # Sparse (MSA) attention with the lightning indexer, or dense attention.
+    sparse: bool
+    moe: bool
+
+
+def default_stages(
+    config: DecodeConfig, backbone: "MiniMaxM3Model | None" = None
+) -> Stages:
+    """The stage implementations of a deployment: the kernel stages
+    (`kernel_stages.py`) that run over its cache dtypes, each ahead of the
+    stock stage. Without a backbone, the stock chain."""
+    stock = stock_stages()
+    # The stock stage object of every slot (the kernel stages delegate to it).
+    stock_by_slot = {name: impls[-1] for name, impls in stock._asdict().items()}
+    if backbone is None:
+        extra: dict[str, list] = {}
+    else:
+        from ..kernel_stages import kernel_stage_lists
+
+        extra = kernel_stage_lists(backbone, config, stock_by_slot)
+    stages = Stages(
+        *([*extra.get(name, ()), *impls] for name, impls in stock._asdict().items())
+    )
+    return stages.for_cache_dtypes(config.cache_dtypes)
+
+
+def captures_pure_decode(prefixes: list[str]) -> bool:
+    """Whether the forward being captured into a CUDA graph is a FULL graph of
+    a pure decode step: not a PIECEWISE capture (Model Runner V2 captures FULL
+    graphs with the forward context's mode NONE, and PIECEWISE ones, which
+    report capturing too, with PIECEWISE), and attention metadata without
+    prefills for every attention layer and index cache in `prefixes`."""
+    context = get_forward_context()
+    attn_metadata = context.attn_metadata
+    if context.cudagraph_runtime_mode == CUDAGraphMode.PIECEWISE or not isinstance(
+        attn_metadata, dict
+    ):
+        return False
+    for prefix in prefixes:
+        metadata = attn_metadata.get(prefix)
+        if metadata is None or getattr(metadata, "num_prefills", 0) > 0:
+            return False
+    return True
+
+
+class SpecializedDecode:
+    """The decode executor over one backbone's local layers."""
+
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        backbone: "MiniMaxM3Model",
+        config: DecodeConfig,
+        lm_head: nn.Module,
+        stages: Stages | None = None,
+    ) -> None:
+        from ...model import MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer, MiniMaxM3SparseAttention
+
+        self.backbone = backbone
+        self.config = config
+        self.lm_head = lm_head
+        self.max_rows = max_rows(config.query_len)
+        self.stages = default_stages(config, backbone) if stages is None else stages
+        if any(not impls for impls in self.stages):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "decode_backend=latency_specialized has no implementation of "
+                f"some stage for the {config.cache_dtypes} caches"
+            )
+        if backbone.use_mega_moe:
+            raise ValueError(
+                "decode_backend=latency_specialized does not run the MegaMoE experts"
+            )
+        self.plans: list[LayerPlan] = []
+        prefixes: set[str] = set()
+        for layer_id in range(backbone.start_layer, backbone.end_layer):
+            layer = backbone.layers[layer_id]
+            assert isinstance(layer, MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer)
+            attn = layer.self_attn
+            sparse = isinstance(attn, MiniMaxM3SparseAttention)
+            if sparse:
+                self._check_sparse_attention(attn)
+                prefixes.add(attn.layer_name)
+                prefixes.add(attn.indexer.index_cache.prefix)
+            else:
+                prefixes.add(attn.attn.layer_name)
+            self.plans.append(
+                LayerPlan(
+                    layer_id=layer_id,
+                    layer=layer,
+                    sparse=sparse,
+                    moe=layer.is_moe_layer,
+                )
+            )
+        self._prefixes = sorted(prefixes)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _check_sparse_attention(attn) -> None:
+        from ...indexer_msa import MiniMaxM3IndexerMSAImpl
+        from ...sparse_attention_msa import MiniMaxM3SparseMSAImpl
+
+        # unsupported() refuses the NVFP4 caches that select the other impls.
+        if not isinstance(attn.indexer.impl, MiniMaxM3IndexerMSAImpl):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "decode_backend=latency_specialized needs the MSA indexer, not "
+                f"{type(attn.indexer.impl).__name__}"
+            )
+        if not isinstance(attn.impl, MiniMaxM3SparseMSAImpl):
+            raise ValueError(
+                "decode_backend=latency_specialized needs the MSA sparse "
+                f"attention, not {type(attn.impl).__name__}"
+            )
+
+    @classmethod
+    def for_target(
+        cls, backbone: "MiniMaxM3Model", config: DecodeConfig, lm_head: nn.Module
+    ) -> "SpecializedDecode":
+        """The executor of the target model's backbone."""
+        return cls(backbone, config, lm_head)
+
+    def plan(
+        self,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+        intermediate_tensors: IntermediateTensors | None,
+    ) -> DecodeStep | None:
+        """The step this forward runs, or None to run the stock layers: only
+        FULL CUDA graph captures of pure decode steps of up to `max_rows`
+        rows run the executor."""
+        rows = positions.shape[0]
+        if (
+            intermediate_tensors is not None
+            or not 0 < rows <= self.max_rows
+            or not is_forward_context_available()
+        ):
+            return None
+        if not torch.cuda.is_current_stream_capturing():
+            # The eager run before each capture (and every eager step) runs the stock
+            # layers, which also compiles the stock kernels.
+            return None
+        if not captures_pure_decode(self._prefixes):
+            return None
+        return DecodeStep(rows=rows, stages=self.stages.select(rows), executor=self)
+
+    def run(
+        self, step: DecodeStep, x: torch.Tensor, positions: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> DecodeOutput:
+        """The decoder layers and the final norm of the step, on the embedding
+        `x`; returns what `MiniMaxM3Model.forward` returns."""
+        backbone = self.backbone
+        aux_layers = backbone.aux_hidden_state_layers
+        aux_hidden_states: list[torch.Tensor] = []
+        s = step.stages
+        for stage in s.distinct():
+            stage.begin_step(step, positions)
+        pending: torch.Tensor | object = x
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None = None
+        plans = self.plans
+        for i, plan in enumerate(plans):
+            layer = plan.layer
+            attn = layer.self_attn
+            if residual is not None and s.front.fuses_input(layer):
+                front, residual = s.front.run_fused(
+                    layer,
+                    pending,  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                    residual,
+                    positions,
+                )
+            else:
+                bound = s.allreduce_norm.input(layer, pending, residual)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                residual = bound.residual
+                front = s.front.run(attn, bound.hidden, positions)
+            # Aux hidden state k is the residual stream entering layer k, read once the
+            # input boundary has reduced it, and cloned (as the stock forward): the
+            # stages update the residual buffers in place.
+            if plan.layer_id in aux_layers:
+                aux_hidden_states.append(residual.clone())
+            if plan.sparse:
+                assert front.index_q is not None
+                scores = s.index_score.run(attn, front.index_q)
+                topk = s.page_topk.run(attn, scores)
+                attn_out = s.sparse_decode.run(attn, front.q, topk)
+            else:
+                attn_out = s.dense_decode.run(attn, front)
+            partial = s.o_proj.run(attn, attn_out)
+            bound = s.allreduce_norm.post_attention(layer, partial, residual)
+            residual = bound.residual
+            hidden = bound.hidden
+            assert isinstance(hidden, torch.Tensor)
+            if plan.moe:
+                moe = layer.block_sparse_moe
+                rows = hidden.shape[0]
+                successor = plans[i + 1].layer if i + 1 < len(plans) else None
+                # A front that fuses the next input boundary lands a BF16 partial, the
+                # push, or (``fuses_finalize``) the unfinalized MoE output.
+                fused_next = successor is not None and s.front.fuses_input(successor)
+                may_defer = not fused_next or s.front.fuses_finalize(successor)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                push = (
+                    fused_next
+                    and s.front.polls_push(successor)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+                    and s.moe.can_push(moe, rows)
+                )
+                pending = s.moe.run(
+                    moe,
+                    hidden,
+                    bound.router_logits,
+                    defer_finalize=may_defer and moe.defers_finalize(rows),
+                    push=push,
+                )
+            else:
+                pending = s.dense_mlp.run(layer.mlp, hidden)
+        assert residual is not None
+        bound = s.allreduce_norm.final(backbone, pending, residual)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+        hidden_states = bound.hidden
+        assert isinstance(hidden_states, torch.Tensor)
+        if backbone.end_layer in aux_layers:
+            aux_hidden_states.append(bound.residual.clone())
+        if aux_hidden_states:
+            return hidden_states, aux_hidden_states
+        return hidden_states

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The model state of the specialized decode.
+
+`MiniMaxM3SpecializedDecodeModelState` is the default model state (which
+MiniMax-M3 runs on without the specialized decode) plus the decode executor,
+built and warmed up once the weights are loaded: the model runner creates the
+model state after loading the target and draft models, and before memory
+profiling and CUDA graph capture.
+
+The attention metadata builds still run eagerly before every step, as in the
+stock decode. Recording them into CUDA graphs (as DeepSeek-V4.1's
+`metadata_graphs` does) needs the MiniMax-M3 sparse and indexer builders
+audited for host reads first, e.g. the CUTLASS sparse decode's plan cache.
+"""
+
+import torch
+from torch import nn
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+from vllm.logger import init_logger
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.mm.encoder_cache import EncoderCache
+from vllm.v1.worker.gpu.model_states.default import DefaultModelState
+
+from .. import MAX_REQUESTS, MAX_SPECULATIVE_TOKENS
+from ..peer_logits import peer_logits, peer_logits_unsupported
+from .warmup import warm_up
+
+logger = init_logger(__name__)
+
+
+class MiniMaxM3SpecializedDecodeModelState(DefaultModelState):
+    def __init__(
+        self,
+        vllm_config: VllmConfig,
+        model: nn.Module,
+        encoder_cache: EncoderCache | None,
+        device: torch.device,
+    ):
+        super().__init__(vllm_config, model, encoder_cache, device)
+        language_model = (
+            model.get_language_model()
+            if hasattr(model, "get_language_model")
+            else model
+        )
+        self.decode = language_model.build_specialized_decode()
+        warm_up(self.decode, vllm_config)
+        self._peer_logits = None
+        reason = peer_logits_unsupported(
+            language_model.lm_head, language_model.logits_processor
+        )
+        if reason:
+            logger.info("Target logits stay gathered: %s.", reason)
+        else:
+            self._peer_logits = peer_logits(
+                language_model.lm_head,
+                language_model.logits_processor,
+                MAX_REQUESTS * (1 + MAX_SPECULATIVE_TOKENS),
+                "target_logits",
+            )
+            logger.info("Target logits: through peer memory.")
+        # Peer buffers, their handshake and kernel compiles now, on every rank in the
+        # same order and before memory profiling: the target's, then the DSpark
+        # drafter's.
+        if self._peer_logits is not None:
+            self._peer_logits.warm_up()
+        spec = vllm_config.speculative_config
+        if spec is not None and spec.num_speculative_tokens:
+            from ..drafter import warm_up_drafters
+
+            warm_up_drafters(int(spec.num_speculative_tokens))
+
+    def compute_sample_logits(self, hidden_states: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        # The same on every TP rank: every rank samples every request.
+        if self._peer_logits is not None:
+            logits = self._peer_logits(hidden_states)
+            if logits is not None:
+                return logits
+        return super().compute_sample_logits(hidden_states)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""Tuning and compiling the specialized decode's stages.
+
+The model state calls `warm_up` once the executor is built, before memory
+profiling and CUDA graph capture, so no kernel compiles or tunes inside a
+capture. Each stage implementation warms up for the row counts it runs; the
+stock stages need nothing (the eager stock forward before each capture
+compiles their kernels). A stage whose warm-up is collective (FlashInfer's
+tuner reduces its timings over the TP group) runs the same calls in the same
+order on every rank, which this order guarantees.
+"""
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm.config import VllmConfig
+
+from .decode import SpecializedDecode
+
+
+def step_rows(decode: SpecializedDecode, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> list[int]:
+    """Every row count an executor step can have: the FULL decode CUDA graph
+    capture sizes up to the executor's `max_rows`."""
+    sizes = vllm_config.compilation_config.cudagraph_capture_sizes or []
+    return sorted({size for size in sizes if 0 < size <= decode.max_rows})
+
+
+def warm_up(decode: SpecializedDecode, vllm_config: VllmConfig) -> None:
+    """Warm every stage implementation up for the step rows it supports."""
+    rows = step_rows(decode, vllm_config)
+    with torch.inference_mode():
+        for stage in decode.stages.all():
+            supported = [r for r in rows if stage.supports(r)]
+            if supported:
+                stage.warm_up(supported)

+# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0
+# SPDX-FileCopyrightText: Copyright contributors to the vLLM project
+"""The per-layer stages of the specialized decode.
+
+A decoder layer of the executor is a chain of stages; each stage has one
+interface below and any number of implementations. `stock.py` implements
+every stage with the ops the stock layers run; a kernel replaces one stage at a
+time by implementing its interface (see `AGENTS.md`).
+
+Shapes are per TP rank. `rows` is the step's token count,
+`c * (K + 1)` for `c` requests and `K` DSpark draft tokens (padded rows
+included), at most `MAX_ROWS`. At TP4 for MiniMax-M3.1-Flash:
+
+======================  =====================================================
+`hidden`              6144
+`q_heads`             16 (64 / TP), `head_dim` 128, `q_size` 2048
+`kv_heads`            1 (4 / TP), `kv_size` 128
+`index_heads`         1 (= `kv_heads`), `index_dim` 128
+`topk_blocks`         16 blocks of 128 tokens (= KV block size)
+`max_k_tiles`         8192 (the indexer's unified score buffer)
+`experts`             128 routed, top 4; expert intermediate 768 (3072 / TP)
+`dense_intermediate`  3072 (12288 / TP), layers 0-2
+======================  =====================================================
+
+Every stage runs inside a FULL CUDA graph capture: it may not synchronize with
+the host or read GPU values back, and every decision it makes must depend only
+on host state shared by all TP ranks (`rows`, module attributes, attention
+metadata host fields). Stages that communicate (`AllReduceNormStage`) must
+issue the same collectives on every rank.
+
+Fused kernel stages. Some kernel implementations cover more than their own
+slot, or hand a private layout to a partner stage instead of the tensor the
+interface below names:
+
+- a `FrontStage` may fuse the input boundary (`fuses_input`): the executor
+  then calls `run_fused` with the previous FFN's pending output and residual
+  instead of `AllReduceNormStage.input` + `run`;
+- an `OProjStage` may return a pending object only its partner
+  `AllReduceNormStage.post_attention` consumes (the o_proj + boundary pair);
+- a `PageTopKStage` may return a private block table only its partner
+  `SparseDecodeStage` reads;
+- a `MoEStage` may push its output straight into the next front's exchange
+  (`can_push`) and return a `PushedFFN`.
+
+`Stage.compatible` states which partners an implementation needs; `select`
+demotes every implementation whose partners are not selected (down to the
+stock one, which composes with everything), so every mix it returns is one
+that is correct. The executor asks `fuses_input` / `polls_push` /
+`can_push` before each boundary, so a push is only ever made to a front that
+consumes it.
+"""
+
+from abc import ABC, abstractmethod
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, NamedTuple, TypeAlias
+
+import torch
+
+from . import STAGE_NAMES, CacheDtypes
+
+if TYPE_CHECKING:
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import MoEOutput
+    from vllm.model_executor.layers.fusion.quant_activation import (
+        QuantizedActivation,
+    )
+
+    from ..model import (
+        MiniMaxM3Attention,
+        MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer,
+        MiniMaxM3MLP,
+        MiniMaxM3Model,
+        MiniMaxM3MoE,
+        MiniMaxM3SparseAttention,
+    )
+    from .runtime.decode import DecodeStep
+
+    LayerInput: TypeAlias = torch.Tensor | QuantizedActivation
+    PendingFFN: TypeAlias = torch.Tensor | MoEOutput | "PushedFFN"
+
+
+class PushedFFN(NamedTuple):
+    """An FFN output its stage already pushed into the exchange the next
+    layer's (input-fusing) front polls. Only a `FrontStage` whose
+    `polls_push` holds for that layer may receive it."""
+
+    # [rows, hidden] BF16: the same un-reduced partial (reading it does not consume the
+    # push).
+    partial: torch.Tensor
+
+
+class FrontOutput(NamedTuple):
+    """The attention inputs a front stage leaves for the next stages."""
+
+    # [rows, q_size]: E4M3 with the layer's ``_q_scale_float`` when the CUTLASS sparse
+    # decode serves the layer (``impl.use_cutlass_decode``), else BF16. QK-normed and
+    # RoPE'd. Dense layers: BF16, a view into the qkv output.
+    q: torch.Tensor
+    # Sparse layers: [rows, index_heads * index_dim], index-normed and RoPE'd: E4M3 for
+    # an fp8 index cache, BF16 for a BF16 one. None on dense layers.
+    index_q: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    # Dense layers only: [rows, kv_size] BF16 K (normed, RoPE'd) and V, views into the
+    # qkv output; the dense decode inserts them into the KV cache.
+    k: torch.Tensor | None = None
+    v: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+
+class BoundaryOutput(NamedTuple):
+    """A sublayer boundary's result: the next sublayer's input and residual."""
+
+    # [rows, hidden]: BF16, or an MXFP8 ``QuantizedActivation`` (E4M3 data [rows,
+    # hidden] + swizzled E8M0 scales) that ``qkv_proj`` reads as is.
+    hidden: "LayerInput"
+    # [rows, hidden] BF16: the all-reduced residual stream after this boundary.
+    residual: torch.Tensor
+    # Post-attention boundaries of MoE layers: [rows, experts] FP32 router logits of
+    # ``hidden``, when the boundary computes them. None otherwise.
+    router_logits: torch.Tensor | None = None
+
+
+class Stage(ABC):  # noqa: B024 (the stage interfaces below add the abstract methods)
+    """What every stage shares."""
+
+    # Short stage name, for logs and test ids (e.g. "front").
+    name: str = ""
+    # Most rows this implementation runs; larger steps take the next implementation of
+    # the stage (finally the stock one, which has no limit).
+    max_rows: int | None = None
+    # The (KV, index-K) cache dtypes this implementation runs, or None for all; other
+    # deployments take the next implementation of the stage.
+    cache_dtypes: frozenset[CacheDtypes] | None = None
+
+    def runs_with(self, dtypes: CacheDtypes) -> bool:
+        """Whether this implementation runs over caches of `dtypes`; decided
+        once, when the executor is built."""
+        return self.cache_dtypes is None or dtypes in self.cache_dtypes
+
+    def supports(self, rows: int) -> bool:
+        """Whether this implementation runs a step of `rows` rows. Host-only
+        and alike on every TP rank."""
+        return self.max_rows is None or rows <= self.max_rows
+
+    def warm_up(self, rows: Sequence[int]) -> None:  # noqa: B027
+        """Compile and tune for every row count in `rows` (each one this
+        stage `supports`), before memory profiling and CUDA graph capture.
+        Collective when the stage is; the stock stages need nothing."""
+
+    def compatible(self, step: "StepStages") -> bool:
+        """Whether this implementation can run beside the other stages of
+        `step` (host-only, alike on every rank). Implementations that hand a
+        private layout to a partner stage return False unless that partner is
+        selected; the stock stages compose with every implementation."""
+        return True
+
+    def begin_step(self, step: "DecodeStep", positions: torch.Tensor) -> None:  # noqa: B027
+        """Called once per step (`step.rows` rows, `positions` [rows]
+        int64), before the first layer, on every selected implementation
+        (e.g. to build step metadata the kernels share). Runs inside the
+        capture: graph-safe ops only."""
+
+
+class FrontStage(Stage):
+    """`qkv_proj` + per-head QK norm + partial RoPE (+ the index branch's
+    norm and RoPE) + the KV and index-K cache insert of sparse layers."""
+
+    name = "front"
+
+    def fuses_input(self, layer: "MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer") -> bool:
+        """Whether this implementation also runs `layer`'s input boundary
+        (the previous FFN's all-reduce, residual add, input norm): then the
+        executor calls `run_fused` instead of `AllReduceNormStage.input` +
+        `run`, and leaves the previous MoE's finalize deferred only when
+        `fuses_finalize`."""
+        return False
+
+    def polls_push(self, layer: "MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer") -> bool:
+        """Whether `run_fused` on `layer` takes a `PushedFFN` (the
+        previous MoE pushed its output into this front's exchange)."""
+        return False
+
+    def fuses_finalize(self, layer: "MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer") -> bool:
+        """Whether `run_fused` on `layer` also takes a `MoEOutput` whose
+        routed output is unfinalized (it runs the previous MoE's top-k
+        reduction and shared add itself), so that MoE may defer."""
+        return False
+
+    def run_fused(
+        self,
+        layer: "MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer",
+        pending: "PendingFFN",
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> tuple[FrontOutput, torch.Tensor]:
+        """The input boundary and `run` in one: `pending` is the previous
+        FFN's un-reduced [rows, hidden] BF16 output, a `MoEOutput` when
+        `fuses_finalize`, or a `PushedFFN` when `polls_push`; `residual`
+        [rows, hidden] BF16. Returns the front's output and the residual stream
+        after the boundary (what `AllReduceNormStage.input` returns as
+        `residual`)."""
+        raise NotImplementedError(f"{type(self).__name__} does not fuse the input")
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def run(
+        self,
+        attn: "MiniMaxM3SparseAttention | MiniMaxM3Attention",
+        hidden: "LayerInput",
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> FrontOutput:
+        """`hidden`: [rows, hidden] BF16 or MXFP8 (the input norm's output).
+        `positions`: [rows] int64.
+
+        Sparse layers write the step's K/V into `attn.kv_cache` (BF16 or fp8
+        E4M3, 128-token blocks, in the MiniMax-M3 sparse backend's layout) and its
+        index K into `attn.indexer.index_cache.kv_cache` (BF16 or fp8 E4M3)
+        at the
+        forward context's slot mappings for `attn.layer_name` and the index
+        cache prefix."""
+
+
+class IndexScoreStage(Stage):
+    """The lightning indexer's decode scores: per query row and index head,
+    the max score of every KV block of the request's context."""
+
+    name = "index_score"
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def run(
+        self, attn: "MiniMaxM3SparseAttention", index_q: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """`index_q`: [rows, index_heads * index_dim], E4M3 or BF16 as the
+        index cache.
+
+        Returns the scores [rows, index_heads, max_k_tiles] FP32: the indexer
+        metadata's `unified_scores` (pre-filled with -inf by the metadata
+        build), with every causally valid block's tile written. The page top-k
+        reads it next."""
+
+
+class PageTopKStage(Stage):
+    """The top `topk_blocks` KV blocks per query row and index head, always
+    including the init and local blocks."""
+
+    name = "page_topk"
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def run(
+        self, attn: "MiniMaxM3SparseAttention", scores: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """`scores`: [rows, index_heads, max_k_tiles] FP32.
+
+        Returns the selected block ids [rows, index_heads, topk_blocks] int32,
+        -1 past the context: a view of the model's shared
+        `topk_indices_buffer` (the sparse decode of the same layer reads it).
+        An implementation whose `compatible` requires a specific
+        `SparseDecodeStage` may instead return its own table for it."""

+
+class SparseDecodeStage(Stage):
+    """Block-sparse GQA decode over the selected blocks of the KV cache."""
+
+    name = "sparse_decode"
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def run(
+        self,
+        attn: "MiniMaxM3SparseAttention",
+        q: torch.Tensor,
+        topk: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """`q`: [rows, q_size] E4M3 or BF16 (`FrontOutput.q`).
+        `topk`: [rows, index_heads, topk_blocks] int32.

+        Returns the attention output [rows, q_size] BF16."""
+
+
+class DenseDecodeStage(Stage):
+    """Full GQA decode of the dense-attention layers (0-2), including their

+
+    name = "dense_decode"

+    @abstractmethod
+    def run(self, attn: "MiniMaxM3Attention", front: FrontOutput) -> torch.Tensor:

+
+class OProjStage(Stage):
+    """`o_proj`: the row-parallel MXFP8 output projection, un-reduced."""
+
+    name = "o_proj"
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def run(
+        self,
+        attn: "MiniMaxM3SparseAttention | MiniMaxM3Attention",
+        attn_out: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """`attn_out`: [rows, q_size] BF16.

+        Returns this rank's partial sum [rows, hidden] BF16; the next
+        `AllReduceNormStage.post_attention` reduces it. An implementation
+        whose `compatible` requires its partner `AllReduceNormStage` may
+        return a pending object instead, which that partner launches with
+        the residual (the fused o_proj + boundary pair)."""
+
+
+class AllReduceNormStage(Stage):
+    """The sublayer boundaries: the TP all-reduce of the previous sublayer's
+    partial output, the residual add and the Gemma RMSNorm (and, after
+    attention on MoE layers, the FP32 router GEMM)."""
+
+    name = "allreduce_norm"
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def input(
+        self,
+        layer: "MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer",
+        pending: "PendingFFN",
+        residual: torch.Tensor | None,
+    ) -> BoundaryOutput:
+        """Into `layer`'s attention. `pending`: the embedding [rows, hidden]
+        BF16 when `residual` is None (layer 0); otherwise the previous FFN's

+        finalize was deferred to this boundary. `residual`: [rows, hidden]
+        BF16."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def post_attention(
+        self,
+        layer: "MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer",
+        partial: torch.Tensor,
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> BoundaryOutput:
+        """Into `layer`'s FFN. `partial`: `o_proj`'s [rows, hidden] BF16
+        (or its partner o_proj's pending object). Returns BF16 `hidden`;
+        `router_logits` [rows, experts] FP32 on MoE layers if this stage
+        computes them (else the MoE stage does)."""
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def final(
+        self,
+        model: "MiniMaxM3Model",
+        pending: "PendingFFN",
+        residual: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> BoundaryOutput:
+        """The final norm after the last layer: `hidden` [rows, hidden] BF16
+        for the LM head, `residual` the residual stream after the last
+        layer."""
+
+
+class MoEStage(Stage):
+    """The MoE FFN: shared expert + NVFP4 routed experts (sigmoid routing with
+    the correction bias, top 4 of 128, renormalized and scaled)."""
+
+    name = "moe"
+
+    def can_push(self, moe: "MiniMaxM3MoE", rows: int) -> bool:
+        """Whether `run(..., push=True)` is possible for `moe` at
+        `rows`: the output can be pushed into the next front's exchange."""
+        return False
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def run(
+        self,
+        moe: "MiniMaxM3MoE",
+        hidden: torch.Tensor,
+        router_logits: torch.Tensor | None,
+        defer_finalize: bool,
+        push: bool = False,
+    ) -> "PendingFFN":
+        """`hidden`: [rows, hidden] BF16. `router_logits`: [rows, experts]
+        FP32, or None to compute them here (or route from the boundary's own
+        hand-off, for a kernel MoE behind its kernel boundary).
+
+        Returns the un-reduced FFN output [rows, hidden] BF16, or with
+        `defer_finalize` a `MoEOutput` whose top-k finalize the next
+        boundary fuses with its all-reduce (an implementation may ignore the
+        hint and return the tensor), or with `push` (only passed when
+        `can_push` and the next front `polls_push`) a `PushedFFN`."""
+
+
+class DenseMLPStage(Stage):
+    """The dense SwiGLU-OAI MLP of layers 0-2 (MXFP8 `gate_up_proj` and
+    `down_proj`)."""
+
+    name = "dense_mlp"
+
+    @abstractmethod
+    def run(self, mlp: "MiniMaxM3MLP", hidden: torch.Tensor) -> torch.Tensor:
+        """`hidden`: [rows, hidden] BF16. Returns the un-reduced output
+        [rows, hidden] BF16."""
+
+
+class Stages(NamedTuple):
+    """The implementations of every stage the executor runs, each a list
+    tried in order: the first that `supports` a step's rows runs it. The
+    last of each list is the stock stage, which supports every step."""
+
+    front: Sequence[FrontStage]
+    index_score: Sequence[IndexScoreStage]
+    page_topk: Sequence[PageTopKStage]
+    sparse_decode: Sequence[SparseDecodeStage]
+    dense_decode: Sequence[DenseDecodeStage]
+    o_proj: Sequence[OProjStage]
+    allreduce_norm: Sequence[AllReduceNormStage]
+    moe: Sequence[MoEStage]
+    dense_mlp: Sequence[DenseMLPStage]
+
+    def for_cache_dtypes(self, dtypes: CacheDtypes) -> "Stages":
+        """The implementations that run over caches of `dtypes`."""
+        return Stages(
+            *([stage for stage in impls if stage.runs_with(dtypes)] for impls in self)  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+        )
+
+    def select(self, rows: int) -> "StepStages":
+        """The implementation of every stage for a step of `rows` rows: per
+        stage the first that `supports` the rows, then, while any selected
+        implementation is not `compatible` with the others, the first such
+        one (in stage order) is replaced by the next supporting implementation
+        of its stage. Implementations only move down their lists and the
+        stock ones are compatible with everything, so this ends, and the
+        result is deterministic (the same on every rank)."""
+        candidates = [
+            [stage for stage in impls if stage.supports(rows)] for impls in self
+        ]
+        for impls, found in zip(self, candidates):
+            if not found:
+                raise ValueError(
+                    f"no implementation of stage {impls[-1].name!r} supports "
+                    f"{rows} rows"
+                    if impls
+                    else "a stage without implementations"
+                )
+        index = [0] * len(candidates)
+        while True:
+            step = StepStages(
+                *(found[i] for found, i in zip(candidates, index))  # type: ignore[arg-type]
+            )
+            demoted = False
+            for slot, stage in enumerate(step):
+                if stage.compatible(step):
+                    continue
+                if index[slot] + 1 >= len(candidates[slot]):
+                    raise ValueError(
+                        f"no implementation of stage {stage.name!r} for {rows} "
+                        "rows is compatible with the other stages"
+                    )
+                index[slot] += 1
+                demoted = True
+                break
+            if not demoted:
+                return step
+
+    def all(self) -> list[Stage]:
+        """Every implementation of every stage, once."""
+        seen: dict[int, Stage] = {}
+        for impls in self:
+            for stage in impls:
+                seen.setdefault(id(stage), stage)
+        return list(seen.values())
+
+
+class StepStages(NamedTuple):
+    """One implementation per stage: the chain of one step."""
+
+    front: FrontStage
+    index_score: IndexScoreStage
+    page_topk: PageTopKStage
+    sparse_decode: SparseDecodeStage
+    dense_decode: DenseDecodeStage
+    o_proj: OProjStage
+    allreduce_norm: AllReduceNormStage
+    moe: MoEStage
+    dense_mlp: DenseMLPStage
+
+    def distinct(self) -> list[Stage]:
+        """Every selected implementation, once (an object may fill several
+        slots)."""
+        seen: dict[int, Stage] = {}
+        for stage in self:
+            seen.setdefault(id(stage), stage)
+        return list(seen.values())
+
+

+"""Every stage on the ops the stock layers run: the stock-op chain.
+
+Each stage below runs exactly the ops `MiniMaxM3DecoderLayer` runs for a pure
+decode step of up to `MAX_ROWS` rows, in the same order and with the same
+arguments, split at the stage boundaries of `stages.py`. Run alone, the chain
+reproduces the stock decode; it is also the last implementation of every
+stage, which a kernel stage falls back to for the steps it does not support.
+
+Two places split one stock call in two:
+
+- `MiniMaxM3IndexerMSAImpl.forward` is `StockIndexScore` (its decode
+  branch) followed by `StockPageTopK` (its unified top-k); executor steps
+  have no prefill rows, so its prefill branch never runs.
+- `MiniMaxM3MoE.forward` computes the router logits, then runs the experts;
+  `StockAllReduceNorm.post_attention` computes the logits and `StockMoE`
+  the experts.
+"""
+
+from collections.abc import Sequence
+from typing import TYPE_CHECKING
+
+import torch
+
+from vllm import _custom_ops as ops
+from vllm.forward_context import get_forward_context
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_allreduce_gemma_rms_norm import (
+    fused_allreduce_gemma_rms_norm,
+)
+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fused_moe.moe_output import (
+    MoEOutput,
+    UnfinalizedMoEOutput,
+)

+from vllm.model_executor.layers.fusion.quant_activation import QuantizedActivation
+
+from .stages import (
+    AllReduceNormStage,
+    BoundaryOutput,
+    DenseDecodeStage,
+    DenseMLPStage,
+    FrontOutput,
+    FrontStage,
+    IndexScoreStage,
+    MoEStage,
+    OProjStage,
+    PageTopKStage,
+    SparseDecodeStage,
+    Stages,

+if TYPE_CHECKING:

+class StockFront(FrontStage):
+    """`MiniMaxM3SparseAttention.forward` / `MiniMaxM3Attention.forward`
+    up to the attention: `qkv_proj` and
+    `fused_minimax_m3_qknorm_rope_kv_insert`. Executor steps stay below the
+    fused qkv epilogue's 512 rows, so it never runs."""
+
+    def run(
+        self,
+        attn: "MiniMaxM3SparseAttention | MiniMaxM3Attention",
+        hidden: "LayerInput",
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> FrontOutput:
+        from ..model import MiniMaxM3SparseAttention
+
+        if not isinstance(attn, MiniMaxM3SparseAttention):
+            return self._dense(attn, hidden, positions)
+        if isinstance(hidden, QuantizedActivation):
+            num_tokens = hidden.orig_shape[0]
+            dtype = hidden.orig_dtype
+        else:
+            num_tokens = hidden.shape[0]
+            dtype = hidden.dtype
+        qkv, _ = attn.qkv_proj(hidden)
+        return self.run_qkv(attn, qkv, num_tokens, dtype, positions)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def run_qkv(
+        attn: "MiniMaxM3SparseAttention",
+        qkv: torch.Tensor,
+        num_tokens: int,
+        dtype: torch.dtype,
+        positions: torch.Tensor,
+    ) -> FrontOutput:
+        """The sparse front after `qkv_proj`: q/k norms, RoPE and the KV /
+        index-K cache insert of `qkv` (a kernel QKV projection reuses it)."""
+        slot_mappings = get_forward_context().slot_mapping
+        assert isinstance(slot_mappings, dict)
+        main_slot_mapping = slot_mappings[attn.layer_name]
+        index_slot_mapping = slot_mappings[attn.indexer.index_cache.prefix]
+        q = attn._allocate_query(num_tokens, dtype, qkv.device)

+        index_q = torch.empty(
+            (num_tokens, attn.index_q_size),
+            dtype=attn.indexer.index_cache.query_dtype,
+            device=qkv.device,
+        )
+        ops.fused_minimax_m3_qknorm_rope_kv_insert(
+            qkv,
+            attn.q_norm.weight,
+            attn.k_norm.weight,
+            attn.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+            positions,
+            attn.num_heads,
+            attn.num_kv_heads,
+            attn.rotary_emb.rotary_dim,
+            attn.q_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            attn.index_q_norm.weight,
+            attn.index_k_norm.weight,
+            attn.num_idx_heads,
+            main_slot_mapping,
+            index_slot_mapping,
+            attn.kv_cache,
+            attn.indexer.index_cache.kv_cache,
+            attn.kv_cache.size(2),  # paged-cache block size
+            None if q_is_fp8 else q,
+            index_q,
+            attn.kv_cache_dtype,
+            q_fp8_out=q if q_is_fp8 else None,
+            q_fp8_scale=attn._q_scale_float,
+            kv_k_scale=attn._k_scale if attn.use_nvfp4_kv else None,
+            kv_v_scale=attn._v_scale if attn.use_nvfp4_kv else None,
+            write_qkv=not q_is_fp8,
+        )
+        return FrontOutput(q=q, index_q=index_q)
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def _dense(
+        attn: "MiniMaxM3Attention", hidden: "LayerInput", positions: torch.Tensor
+    ) -> FrontOutput:
+        qkv, _ = attn.qkv_proj(hidden)
+        ops.fused_minimax_m3_qknorm_rope_kv_insert(
+            qkv,
+            attn.q_norm.weight,
+            attn.k_norm.weight,
+            attn.rotary_emb.cos_sin_cache,
+            positions,
+            attn.num_heads,
+            attn.num_kv_heads,
+            attn.rotary_emb.rotary_dim,
+            attn.q_norm.variance_epsilon,
+            kv_cache_dtype="auto",
+        )
+        q, k, v = qkv.split([attn.q_size, attn.kv_size, attn.kv_size], dim=-1)
+        return FrontOutput(q=q, k=k, v=v)
+

+    (or Triton, for wide query tiles) decode score into the unified score

+    def run(
